description: Three banks of sixteen faders and three single knobs, held in a hundred slots that a voltage can step through

params.text: Sets the voltage on its channel of its bank's output, over the span chosen in the menu for that bank
Attenuates the voltage at the Mod CV jack of its bank before it is added to those faders, 0 to 1
Picks which of the hundred slots is played and edited
While on, the slot is picked by hand and a cable in the preset jack no longer moves the selection
Copies every fader and knob of the slot being edited
Writes the copied faders and knobs into the slot being edited
Sets how long the faders and knobs take to reach their new values after a slot change, 0 to 10
A single knob with an output of its own, over -10V to 10V, saved with the slot like the faders
Pushes the slots after the one being edited along by one place and empties it; the hundredth slot is lost
Removes the slot being edited and pulls every later slot back one place

inputs.text: Modulates the faders of its bank, one channel per fader, scaled by the knob beside it
Picks the slot by voltage, 0.1V per slot over 0-10V; while LOCK is on this jack is passed over

outputs.text: The sixteen faders of its bank as one polyphonic cable, with as many channels as the menu is set to for that bank
The voltage of its knob, glided like the faders

notes: click anywhere on a fader to send it straight to the mouse, rather than dragging it from where it stands
the three banks are set up one at a time: the menu carries a channel count, a voltage span, a snap size and a randomise for each of them in turn
with PAD2 placed immediately to the left, hovering over this module and pressing f fetches that module's 48 partials into the three banks and its bandwidth and scale into the first two knobs
menu: Polyphonic Channels — sets how many faders of that bank reach its output, 1 to 16
Range — sets the span of every fader of that bank: -10/10V, -5/5V, -3/3V, -2/2V, -1/1V, 0/10V, 0/5V, 0/3V, 0/2V or 0/1V
Snap Size — rounds that bank's output to a step: None, Semi, 0.1, Pat 32, 0.5, Pat 16, 1 or Pat 8, where Pat X means ten volts divided by X, for addressing patterns elsewhere
Randomize — fills that bank's faders at random within its span
